summary: Comprehensive backend testing of Samvedna/संवेदना API (20 pytest cases, all passed). Covered seed idempotency, dual-OTP auth happy path and security edge cases (invalid OTP 400, max 3 attempts 429, email-before-mobile 409), SVI engine weights (0.45/0.35/0.20) and safety override for self-harm/threat, case CRUD (create+list+patch), bilingual draft (>400 chars each), counsellor OTP login + queue sorted by SVI desc, escalation flow (stage=Filed, status=mock_submitted_to_NHAA), supervisor-only audit log (403 for counsellor), and support directory (6 entries).

minor.issue: Attempts counter is incremented BEFORE checking the OTP, so a correct OTP still consumes an attempt. After 2 wrong submissions a legitimate correct OTP on the 3rd try returns 429 instead of success. Consider only incrementing on failure.

Idempotency relies on both users_cnt AND cases_cnt being >0. If cases collection is cleared but users remain, re-seed will re-insert 5 new case rows (no case-level dedupe). Low risk but non-strict idempotency.
OTP expiry (expires_at) is not checked (unlike /auth/verify-mobile and /auth/verify-email). Counsellor OTPs effectively never expire until attempts cap is hit.

Draft endpoint auto-advances stage to 'Drafted' on every GET. A victim viewing a 'Filed' or escalated case will have stage overwritten back to 'Drafted'-style set (set logic preserves, but updates stage field directly). Should be guarded.
No cleanup/pagination; all tests leave TEST_ cases behind. Not blocking, but accumulates.

action_items: Consider only incrementing OTP attempts on failure (currently correct code after 2 wrong attempts still fails with 429).
Add expires_at check in /api/counsellor/verify for parity with victim verify endpoints.
Guard /api/cases/{case_id}/draft from downgrading stage of already-Filed cases.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~640 lines and mixes auth, cases, counsellor, supervisor, support, seed, dev — consider splitting into routers (auth.py, cases.py, counsellor.py) for maintainability.
JWT_SECRET falls back to a hardcoded dev secret; backend/.env sets it explicitly but production deployments without the env var will silently use the weak default.
DEV_MODE derivation (line 48) uses `not (A and B and C) or not (D and E)` — subtle precedence; works but add parentheses for clarity.
audio_b64 is stored as pseudo_encrypted SHA-prefix + first 200 raw chars — original data is partially retained in plaintext; acknowledged as prototype but worth a code comment.
test_credentials: DEV_MODE active; OTPs returned in request-otp response. Seeded users: victim.demo@samvedna.in / +919999988888, priya.counsellor@samvedna.in, verma.supervisor@samvedna.in.
seed_data_creation: Used POST /api/seed; created 2 counsellors + 1 victim + 5 demo cases (idempotent on repeat).
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs under pytest-xdist (2 workers). Backend passes 20/20. Minor logic improvements suggested (OTP attempt counter, counsellor expiry, draft stage guard) but none block MVP.
